item.description:

The "No Parking" cones were replaced with the water-filled traffic barriers some time ago, so they are no longer required and should now be removed by the Council.

item.title: No longer getting a signal on our sky box due to the trees outside our property, 7th September
item.description:
We have been getting problems with the signal of our sky box to the point we could no longer watch anything. A sky engineer came out and tested the signal, then went outside and said it's the two trees outside our house and outside number 5 Ronaldstone Road. Everytime the wind blows the signal drops out. The trees have got so big and close together now, the gap between the trees is minimal and now stopping us getting a signal with our satallite dish. We need these trees pruned back like they were before. They have grown huge now and the branches are constantly over our driveway now with birds constantly pooing onto our drive and all over the pavement. It is getting disgusting to walk by the tree.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 3, Ronaldstone Road, Blackfen, Sidcup, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
